changelog: [When to Segment]: added two generalized rules for under-segmented cases — split by default after self-contained adverbial clauses ending in patterns like -末、/-すえに、 when an independent main clause follows, and after comma-marked topic/contrast openers (e.g. ところが...となると、) when a self-contained clause with its own verb follows, even without a listed discourse marker, to close the under-segmentation gap the critic flagged.

[Never Segment]: added three new trap rules to prevent the wrong-boundary errors the critic found — (1) never split right before a conditional/temporal connective (-と、-ば、) that governs an ambiguous quantifier/number in the preceding clause, (2) never split a concessive/background clause (-のですが、-けれど(も)、) away from the main clause carrying the sentence's tense, (3) never split immediately after a short quoted exclamation when the following clause introduces or re-uses a proper noun needing consistent localization.
